card.text: WASP-24 b was found in 2010 by SuperWASP as it crossed its star.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "WASP-24"
sources.quote: WASP-24 is an F-type star with the hot Jupiter planet WASP-24b in orbit, about 1,075 light-years away in the constellation Virgo.

introduction.text: It is the only planet known around WASP-24. Its orbit and size follow Stassun et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "WASP-24"
sources.quote: WASP-24 is slightly larger and more massive than the Sun, it also has a similar metallicity and is hotter than the Sun.
